title: BoardGameGeek Hotness
content:
1. **Cola Wars**
*2026*
It's 1985.  You're in charge of marketing for a radical cola brand.  Enjoy, or else.
![Cola Wars](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-14/toplist/bgg_30d171ab.jpg)

2. **Timespan**
*2026*
Lead your civilization from the stone age to the space age in 90 minutes.
![Timespan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-14/toplist/bgg_654ca3a6.jpg)

3. **Hellas**
*2016*
Expand your cities, glorifying them with magnificent structures to vie for victory!
![Hellas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-14/toplist/bgg_7180aa99.jpg)

4. **Magical Athlete**
*2025*
Pit a cast of crazy characters against each other in a madcap race to the finish.
![Magical Athlete](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-14/toplist/bgg_d6a388cb.png)

5. **Dino Battle!**
*2027*
Ride. Roar. Conquer. A dinosaur riding dice-chucking miniatures game for 2-4 players.
![Dino Battle!](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-14/toplist/bgg_471c8558.png)

*2025*
Step into the shoes of an iconic Star Trek captain and explore the galaxy!

*2004*
All aboard!  Collect trains, choo-choo-choose your routes, fulfill your destination!

*2024*
Search for signs of alien life by launching probes and analyzing distant signals.

*2018*

24. **Tend**
*2025*
Farm, explore, and fish on an alien world.
